description: This file defines test filters for the Starboard Xbox One platform, including specific test exclusions for different test categories, and a class that extends shared test filters to include these exclusions.

classes.name: Xb1TestFilters
classes.description: A class that extends shared test filters to include Xbox One specific test exclusions.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of test filters to exclude certain tests during unit testing, combining shared filters with Xbox One specific filters.
